conventions.boundary_priority: On shared boundary cycles: DMA > producer write/ACK > read > descriptor > residual. Ties within a channel go to the already pending owner. Overlaps are counted separately.
conventions.denominator: Fixed 512 Matrix lanes times the complete accepted-to-done interval, including all waiting and serial Norm/RoPE time; never active-lane-normalized.
conventions.environment: Randomized test-fabric request stalls and service/ACK delays, including the testbench 512-cycle RoPE-store delay. Not physical DDR bandwidth, isolated hardware compute latency, PPA, or a whole-block metric.
conventions.exclusive_interval: accepted_start through done, both endpoints included
conventions.matrix: Matrix input-fire timestamps are not recorded. Accepted input count comes from terminal/projection counters. matrix events are observed accepted OUTPUT handshakes, counted separately even when overlapping other owners.
conventions.norm: Norm compute boundary is last gamma response+1 through recorded Norm result inclusive; its input-fire timestamp is unavailable.
conventions.overlapping_observables: Interval totals and handshake counts are diagnostics, overlap exclusive buckets and each other, and must never be added to the cycle denominator.
conventions.reset: Reset-flushed commands have no done/terminal interval and are excluded from completed-command cycle aggregates.
conventions.residuals: Residual cycles between observed boundaries include unlogged request admission, control, input handshakes and pipeline time. Read admission is not isolated from Matrix input/control. Read-owner waits include injected test-fabric response delays. These are not measurements of isolated compute latency or valid&&!ready stalls.
conventions.rope: RoPE compute boundary is last trig response+1 through first RoPE write-1. No separate RoPE result/input-fire event is recorded.
conventions.service_owners: DMA, descriptor, and producer write ownership includes accepted request and response/ACK cycles. Read request is one cycle; read owner wait is request+1 through response inclusive.
